items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: "And then he was with Luncford for a while. I'm almost sure he was with Luncford for awhile.."

ctx.x: Well, this was before I left Chicago. He was with -- I think he -- who was he with? Some band out of Kansas City. And then he was with Luncford for a while. I'm almost sure he was with Luncford for awhile.. But anyway this is how I got my first electric guitar. But then as I said I went into the army and after that I stayed for four years, and I played around, and I did -- when I was in the army I got a chance to do a lot of things musically. I had time to think about the guitar, and to practice. Well, you know,…

But normally I had a chance to really kind of get it together, to formulate all the things, you know, that I had been -- because it was like, being on the inside looking out or outside looking in. I don't know, I could see what they were doing, but there I could get away from it. I was almost like an observer, you know. I would go to New York and I would see what everybody was doing, and I had a chance to compare, and I would go back and I would just work, and work. So actually it wasn't a total loss.
